title: Sprite library — supplied reference set
integrationStatus: Review only — not installed in the game
note: Original PNG files preserved byte-for-byte. Rectangles are display-only atlas regions. Standalone alternatives are retained separately. Names reproduce sheet captions; they do not change gameplay or unit definitions.

plainsPlacement.status: Design instruction only; not implemented in game
plainsPlacement.rule: Most plains use flowerless artwork. Restrict flowers to a few specific local areas, forming occasional small irregular clusters. Vary floral artwork within clusters; never scatter flowers uniformly over the whole map. No floral variant may exceed original 001 flower coverage.
